# Per-worker tokens

<!-- Generated by `go run docs/roadmap/gen.go docs` from tickets.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Phase:** [P1 · Who did it](../README.md#phase-1--who-did-it) · **Lane:** Control plane · **Label:** `feature:worker-credentials` · **Epic:** [#50](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/50) · **Tickets:** 4 (2S 2M)

The control plane issues a separate token per worker, shown once, stored hashed, bound to that worker's proxy id, revocable, and with last-used tracking. Workers use it for /policy, heartbeat and ingest, and the single shared WARDEN_CP_TOKEN is retired through a documented migration. Workers need no code change, because `controlPlane.tokenEnv` now carries the worker's own token.

## How we build it

- Token format `wwt_` + base32(32 random bytes). The CP stores sha256(token), which is sufficient for 256-bit random secrets, in cpstate `worker_tokens(id, name, proxy_id, token_hash UNIQUE, created_by, created_at, last_used_at, revoked_at)`.
- New seam `WorkerAuthenticator.Authenticate(r *http.Request) (WorkerPrincipal, error)`. It replaces `bearerOK`, the token compare in `policyServer.ServePolicy`, and the string token in `analytics.NewIngestHandler`. A token is bound to proxy_id, and `X-Warden-Proxy-ID` must match or the request gets 403.
- `last_used_at` is updated in memory and flushed to the DB every 60s. Revocation takes effect on the next request; held long-polls are rechecked when they wake.
- Admin surfaces: `GET/POST /dashboard/api/worker-tokens`, `DELETE /dashboard/api/worker-tokens/{id}` (admin), and the offline bootstrap CLI `warden control-plane token create|list|revoke --state-dir`.
- Migration: `--legacy-token-env` (and the deprecated `--token-env` alias) keeps accepting the shared token with a per-worker warning, a `legacy` badge in the fleet view and the metric `warden_cp_legacy_token_requests_total`. `--require-worker-tokens` rejects it.

## Done when

Two workers run with distinct tokens. Revoking one makes its next /policy, heartbeat and ingest return 401 while the other keeps working, and a CP started with --require-worker-tokens rejects WARDEN_CP_TOKEN.

### 1/4 · W-P1-WTOK-01

**Add worker token store with hashed storage and revocation**

Type **feature** · Size **S** · Issue [#51](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/51)

Add the `worker_tokens` migration and a `WorkerTokenStore` in internal/controlplane: `Create(name, proxyID, actor) (plaintext string, Token, error)`, `Lookup(hash)`, `Revoke(id)`, `List()` and `MarkUsed(id, t)` with a 60s batched flush. Generate tokens with crypto/rand. Plaintext is returned only from Create and never logged.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] The stored row contains only the hash, and Lookup of a revoked token returns ErrRevoked
- [ ] MarkUsed bursts collapse into one write per flush interval

**Depends on:** [`W-P1-SSO-01`](console-sso-rbac.md#16--w-p1-sso-01) Add internal/cpstate SQLite state store with migrations

**Unblocks:** [`W-P1-WTOK-02`](worker-credentials.md#24--w-p1-wtok-02) Authenticate /policy, heartbeat and ingest with per-worker tokens

### 2/4 · W-P1-WTOK-02

**Authenticate /policy, heartbeat and ingest with per-worker tokens**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#52](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/52)

Introduce `WorkerAuthenticator` in internal/controlplane and use it in `ServePolicy`, `handleHeartbeat`, and the ingest path. Change `analytics.NewIngestHandler` to take an `func(*http.Request) (proxyID string, ok bool)` authorizer instead of a token string, keeping a helper for the old form. Enforce proxy-id binding. Recheck the token when a held long-poll wakes before writing 200.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] A valid token with a mismatched X-Warden-Proxy-ID gets 403 on all three endpoints
- [ ] A revoked token gets 401 on its next request, including when a long-poll wakes
- [ ] Existing ingest tests pass using the helper

**Depends on:** [`W-P1-WTOK-01`](worker-credentials.md#14--w-p1-wtok-01) Add worker token store with hashed storage and revocation

**Unblocks:** [`W-P1-WTOK-03`](worker-credentials.md#34--w-p1-wtok-03) Add worker token admin API, dashboard panel and bootstrap CLI

### 3/4 · W-P1-WTOK-03

**Add worker token admin API, dashboard panel and bootstrap CLI**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#53](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/53)

Add `GET/POST /dashboard/api/worker-tokens` and `DELETE /dashboard/api/worker-tokens/{id}` (admin), with the plaintext returned once in the POST response. Extend `dashboard.WorkerView` with `TokenName`, `TokenLastUsed`, `AuthKind` (token|legacy). Add a `token` subcommand under `control-plane` (`create --name --proxy-id`, `list`, `revoke --id`) that opens cpstate directly for bootstrap before any admin can log in. Admin audit target is `worker_tokens`.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] The dashboard shows the token once, and a later GET never contains plaintext
- [ ] The CLI-created token works against a running CP sharing the same state dir
- [ ] Create and revoke appear in the admin audit log with actor `cli` for CLI use

**Depends on:** [`W-P1-WTOK-02`](worker-credentials.md#24--w-p1-wtok-02) Authenticate /policy, heartbeat and ingest with per-worker tokens; [`W-P1-SSO-05`](console-sso-rbac.md#56--w-p1-sso-05) Map groups to roles and enforce role checks on dashboard APIs; [`W-P1-AAUD-02`](admin-audit-log.md#23--w-p1-aaud-02) Record every CP mutation via audit middleware with state hashers

**Unblocks:** [`W-P1-WTOK-04`](worker-credentials.md#44--w-p1-wtok-04) Retire WARDEN_CP_TOKEN with a legacy mode and migration guide

### 4/4 · W-P1-WTOK-04

**Retire WARDEN_CP_TOKEN with a legacy mode and migration guide**

Type **chore** · Size **S** · Issue [#54](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/54)

Add `--legacy-token-env` (with `--token-env` kept as a deprecated alias) and `--require-worker-tokens` in `cmd/proxy/controlplane.go`. Legacy-auth requests log one warning per proxy id per hour, increment `warden_cp_legacy_token_requests_total{proxy_id}`, and mark the worker `legacy`. Update `docs/control-plane.md` with the step-by-step migration and update all existing compose recipes, starting with `docker-compose.control-plane.yml` to bootstrap a worker token with the CLI.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] With --require-worker-tokens, the shared token gets 401 and a startup log states the mode
- [ ] The control-plane compose recipe comes up with a per-worker token and no WARDEN_CP_TOKEN

**Depends on:** [`W-P1-WTOK-03`](worker-credentials.md#34--w-p1-wtok-03) Add worker token admin API, dashboard panel and bootstrap CLI
